title: Evaluation of the influence of the implementation of structured therapy education on oral health-related self-efficacy in periodontitis patients – a cohort study by the University Hospital of Cologne
summary:
Periodontitis is a chronic inflammation of the periodontium, which, if left untreated, can lead to tooth loosening and tooth loss. Successful treatment requires the cooperation of patients, especially through good oral hygiene and regular follow-up appointments. Systematic periodontitis therapy includes detailed information about the disease, its causes, and the treatment process. This information is intended to help optimize oral hygiene habits and actively support the treatment.
The aim of this study is to investigate the effectiveness of standardized, structured therapy information in periodontitis therapy. At the beginning of their periodontitis treatment, all participants receive an information and treatment consultation as well as oral hygiene instruction. Until now, this has taken the form of a free-flowing conversation.
The participants in the first cohort (control group) receive the free-flowing, verbal consultation in accordance with our previous procedure. Participants in the second cohort will receive this consultation based on the newly introduced structured consultation procedure. In addition, they will receive an oral hygiene flyer and a “Paro Pass,” which is based on the dental bonus booklet and records the discussion in writing.

interventions.name: Verbal information and therapy consultation using structured discussion techniques and support from flyers

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. For patients with statutory health insurance, an approved periodontal therapy application from the health insurance company.
2. The patient is able to give informed consent to participate in the study or has a legal representative who can do so on their behalf.
Exclusion criteria:
1.	The patient is unable to participate in the survey due to a lack of German language skills.
2. Systematic periodontitis therapy in the past 2 years.
